notes: This split governs all FUTURE training/evaluation of the depression models. depression_model.pkl and depression_bert_model/ were trained BEFORE this split existed and were not constrained to exclude these test rows. Metrics computed against those already-trained models are NOT a valid final generalization estimate -- they only verify that the evaluation pipeline itself is correct. Valid final numbers require retraining both models using depression_train.csv / depression_val.csv only, in a future phase.
